Every patient-chart declaration that calls `useVisit` is listed below, best first. The hook itself is defined in openmrs-esm-core, and the chart code consumes it through `@openmrs/esm-framework`. Most of these components read `activeVisit` or call `mutate` on the result, so a change in return shape or refetch behaviour would hit them directly.

**Direct consumers in the chart app (most exposed first):**

1. `usePatientChartPatientAndVisit` (lines 73–238) calls `useVisit(isVisitContextValid ? null : patientUuid)` and drives the chart's visit-context restore on entry. This is the most sensitive caller, since it depends on the null-key skip and on `mutate`/`isValidating`. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-chart/patient-chart.resources.ts`
2. `ExportedVisitForm` (lines 115–716) reads `activeVisit` and `isLoading` to decide edit versus create and to gate the form. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/exported-visit-form.workspace.tsx`
3. `VisitForm` (lines 32–64) uses `mutate` to refresh the active visit after save. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/visit-form.workspace.tsx`
4. `EndVisitDialog` (lines 20–80) reads `activeVisit` and `mutate` to end the visit. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-prompt/end-visit-dialog.modal.tsx`
5. `StopVisitOverflowMenuItem` (lines 16–37) hides the menu item unless `activeVisit` is set. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/stop-visit.component.tsx`
6. `DeleteVisitOverflowMenuItem` (lines 16–39) has the same `activeVisit` gating as the stop item and passes it to the delete modal. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/delete-visit.component.tsx`
7. `VisitAttributeTags` (lines 36–64) filters `activeVisit.attributes` for the banner. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-banner-tags/visit-attribute-tags.extension.tsx`
8. `useOptimisticVisitMutations` (lines 21–193) in the shared common-lib. It is used by the chart app and its SWR cache updates depend on the visit data `useVisit` returns. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/visit-mutations.ts`
9. `VisitTag` (lines 13–21) in the banner app, reads `activeVisit` and `isLoading` to show the visit tag. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/visit-tag.extension.tsx`

**Framework definition (the source of the behaviour change):**

10. `useVisit(patientUuid, representation)` at line 52 of the core hook. Its return type `VisitReturnType` is defined at lines 12–29. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useVisit.ts`

The core line numbers come from Falkon's reference output; I did not read the full function bodies. The chart line ranges come from local reads, and the ends of the blocks are the closing braces I confirmed by grep.

**Not covered:**
- Test files and framework mocks (`mock.tsx`, `mock-jest.tsx`, the Storybook mock) also reference `useVisit`. They would need updating if the return shape changed, but they are not runtime consumers, so I left them out.
- The Falkon grep found two `export … useVisit` matches in `openmrs-esm-patient-management`. I did not check whether that is a separate hook or a re-export, so it may be a second definition worth reviewing.
- The `revalidation-utils.ts` comments mention `useVisit` but do not call it.
